```{r}
source("feature_engineering_functions.R")
training_data <- readRDS("training_data.rds")

X24_25 <- read.csv("Premier League match events data/24_25.csv")
X25_26 <- read.csv("Premier League match events data/25_26.csv")

X25_26_training <- build_season_dataset(
  current_data = X25_26,
  previous_data = X24_25,
  season_label = "2025/26",
  0.1
)

poisson_formula <- Goals ~ DSTF + TeamRankCategory + HomeAway + opp_defence_score + 
    DCS + attack_score + OpponentRankCategory + DLF + DSF + DYF
```

```{r}
# Train on all seasons before 2025/26
poisson_model_final <- glm(
  poisson_formula,
  data = training_data,
  family = poisson(link = "log")
)

# Predict goals for each team in 2025/26
X25_26_training <- X25_26_training %>%
  mutate(
    predicted_goals = predict(
      poisson_model_final,
      newdata = X25_26_training,
      type = "response"
    )
  )
```

```{r}
match_predictions_25_26 <- X25_26_training %>%
  select(
    Year, match_id, HomeAway, Team, Goals, predicted_goals
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = HomeAway,
    values_from = c(Team, Goals, predicted_goals)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    goal_difference =
      predicted_goals_Home - predicted_goals_Away,

    predicted_result = case_when(
      abs(goal_difference) <= 0.473	 ~ "D",
      goal_difference > 0.473	 ~ "H",
      TRUE ~ "A"
    ),

    actual_result = case_when(
      Goals_Home > Goals_Away ~ "H",
      Goals_Home < Goals_Away ~ "A",
      TRUE ~ "D"
    ),

    predicted_home_points = case_when(
      predicted_result == "H" ~ 3,
      predicted_result == "D" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),

    predicted_away_points = case_when(
      predicted_result == "A" ~ 3,
      predicted_result == "D" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),

    actual_home_points = case_when(
      actual_result == "H" ~ 3,
      actual_result == "D" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    ),

    actual_away_points = case_when(
      actual_result == "A" ~ 3,
      actual_result == "D" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  )
```

```{r}
points_by_team_match <- bind_rows(
  match_predictions_25_26 %>%
    transmute(
      Year, match_id,
      Team = Team_Home,
      HomeAway = "Home",
      points_gained = actual_home_points,
      predicted_points = predicted_home_points
    ),

  match_predictions_25_26 %>%
    transmute(
      Year, match_id,
      Team = Team_Away,
      HomeAway = "Away",
      points_gained = actual_away_points,
      predicted_points = predicted_away_points
    )
)

X25_26_training <- X25_26_training %>%
  left_join(
    points_by_team_match,
    by = c("Year", "match_id", "Team", "HomeAway")
  )
```

```{r}
league_table_25_26 <- X25_26_training %>%
  group_by(Team) %>%
  summarise(
    PredictedPoints = sum(predicted_points, na.rm = TRUE),
    ActualPoints = sum(points_gained, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(PredictedPoints)) %>%
  mutate(
    PredictedRank = row_number()
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(ActualPoints)) %>%
  mutate(
    ActualRank = row_number()
  )

league_table_25_26
```
```{r}
pm <- function(predicted, actual) {
  
  n <- length(actual)
  # Identify the top five teams
  P5 <- which(predicted <= 5)
  A5 <- which(actual <= 5)

  # Calculate overlap between predicted and actual top five
  overlap <- length(intersect(P5, A5)) / 5

  # Identify bottom three positions
  bottom3 <- (n - 2):n

  wt <- numeric(n)

  for (i in 1:n) {

    p <- predicted[i]
    a <- actual[i]

    d <- abs(p - a)

    if (a <= 5) { # Actual position is in the top five
      
      if (p == a) {
        w <- 1

      } else if (p <= 5) {
        w <- overlap

      } else {
        w <- -(1 - exp(-d))
      }

    } else {# Actual position is outside the top five

      if (a %in% bottom3) {# Actual team is in the bottom three

        if (p %in% bottom3) {
          w <- 1

        } else {
          w <- -(1 - exp(-d))
        }

      } else if (p <= 5) {# Incorrectly predicted in the top five
        
        w <- -(1 - exp(-d))

      } else if (p == a) {# Correctly predicted outside the top five

        w <- 0.5

      } else {# Incorrectly predicted outside the top five
        k <- 0.1
        w <- -(1 - exp(-k * d))
      }
    }

    wt[i] <- w
  }

  return(sum(wt))
}

pm_adjusted <- function(predicted, actual, historical_features, season_features, total_features, lambda_H = 1, lambda_S = 2) {

  original_pm <- pm(predicted, actual)

  penalty_H <- lambda_H *(historical_features / total_features)

  penalty_S <- lambda_S *(season_features / total_features)

  adjusted_pm <- original_pm - penalty_H - penalty_S

  return(adjusted_pm)
}
pm_adjusted(predicted = league_table_25_26$PredictedRank, actual = league_table_25_26$ActualRank, historical_features = 3, season_features = 6, total_features = 22, lambda_H = 1, lambda_S = 2)
```
